combo_label: At the Supermarket × Sailing & Boats × Robin Hood

entries.clue: Scribbled before you leave home, then ticked off item by item
The adjective every telling fixes to Robin's men, whatever their mood
Biggest workhorse in a yacht's wardrobe of canvas, hoisted up the tallest spar
Mendicant brother in a rope-belted habit; Tuck is the famously stout one
Land under the king's own hunting law, where his deer were untouchable
Inflatable cushion hung over the side so a hull doesn't grind on the quay
Nottinghamshire haunt of Robin's band, home to the ancient Major Oak
Huge balloon of light nylon bellied out ahead when the wind is behind
Numbered lane between the shelves; also where a bride walks
Booked window of time in which the grocery van should arrive
